# A heading that is longer than the width stays on its line

Wrapping fills each line up to the width
with as many words as fit, but optimal
fit balances the lines so that none is
left much shorter than the others. Soft
breaks are just spaces.

Some words never break:
`a code span with spaces`, a
[link](<https://example.com/a path> "with a title"),
an autolink
<https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/overflows>,
inline <abbr title="HyperText Markup Language">HTML</abbr>,
and $x + y = z$ math.

A word that lands at the start of a line
is escaped where it would start a block:
1\. or - or # or > or + or 2) all stay
text, whatever line they land on.

A hard break\
always ends a line, even when the next
